# Harmony

> Harmony is an AI automation agency for B2B teams. We build personalized AI agents and workflows that run customer success, hiring and onboarding, and team productivity in the background, so founders can lead the business instead of the busywork.

Harmony works inside the tools teams already use (Gmail, Slack, Calendar, Notion, HubSpot, Salesforce, and more). Engagements are done-for-you: we audit your current flows, then build, run, and maintain custom agents, workflows, and dashboards. Plans start at the Growth tier and scale up to Enterprise.
